description:
Refactor the 'ReportService' class to remove duplicated code using the Extract Method tool.

The class contains two methods, 'generateDailyReport' and 'generateWeeklyReport', which both start with the exact same 6 lines of code to generate a report header.

Your task:
1. Open 'src/main/java/com/corp/reporting/ReportService.java' in the CorporateReporting project.
2. Select the duplicated header generation code (approx. lines 12-17) inside 'generateDailyReport'.
3. Use Eclipse's 'Extract Method' refactoring (Alt+Shift+M or Right-click > Refactor > Extract Method).
4. Name the new method 'appendReportHeader'.
5. CRITICAL: Ensure you check the option to replace duplicate occurrences so that 'generateWeeklyReport' is also updated.
6. Finish the refactoring.
7. Run the tests (Right-click project > Run As > JUnit Test) to verify nothing broke.
